Name: Matching Maru Sprite

Description:
[size=4]
[color=#b6d7a8]This is a sprite mod that goes with Bunnihime's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/97/?]Villagers Anime Portraits[/url] mod so if you haven't seen it already, go check it out! [/color][/size][color=#b6d7a8][size=2](I have gotten permission to post)[/size][/color][size=4][color=#b6d7a8] 
[/color]
If you're interested, check out my other mods: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1349/?]Less Creepy Marnie Sprite[/url] &  [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1884]Espeon Cat[/url]

[/size][center][/center][center]* [size=3][i]Also if you have any suggestions for this mod feel free to let me know! Feedback is always welcome [/i][/size]*[/center]


[b][color=#9fc5e8][size=3]To Install:
[/size][/color][/b][size=3][color=#9fc5e8]------------

1. Download the file

2. Go to your Stardew Valley folder > Contents > Characters 

3. Find [b]Maru.xnb[/b] and rename to [b]Maru.xnb.bck[/b], then rename [b]Maru_Hospital.xnb[/b] to [b]Maru_Hospital.xnb.bck[/b] (Doing this
    backs up the original file and keeps it inactive in it's folder so you never lose it)

4. Unzip the downloaded file

5. Place the new [b]Maru.xnb[/b] and [b]Maru_Hospital.xnb [/b]in the characters folder (Make sure to leave [b]Maru.xnb.bck[/b] and        
    [b]Maru_Hospital.xnb.bck[/b] in the same folder)

6. Yay!! You're done! [/color]


[color=#b4a7d6][b]To Uninstall:[/b]
---------------

1. Go to your Stardew Valley folder > Contents > Characters

2. Find [b]Maru.xnb[/b] and[b] Maru_Hospital.xnb[/b] and remove them (put them in another folder, delete them, whatever you want)

3. Rename [b]Maru.xnb.bck[/b] back to [b]Maru.xnb[/b] and [b]Maru_Hospital.xnb.bck[/b] back to [b]Maru_Hospital.xnb[/b]

4. That's all! Launch the game


[/color][/size][u]Note[/u]: When you rename the files it will pop up a thing saying something like "this file could become unusable", you can click yes and the files will be fine don't worry
